origin.description: Report whether each string contains at least one literal match.
origin.usage: stri_detect_fixed(str, pattern, negate = FALSE, max_count = -1, ..., opts_fixed = NULL)

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: Character vector of strings to search.

arguments.name: negate
arguments.text: If TRUE, report strings that do not match.

arguments.name: max_count
arguments.text: Stop after this many results of interest. -1 inspects every element. Later elements are NA.

origin.details: Recycling follows the longer input. When pattern is not a single string, elements may be visited out of order, which changes which tail becomes NA once max_count is reached. An empty string follows negate. An empty pattern or a missing value is NA. A missing opts_fixed uses case-sensitive search without overlap. A dict may set case_insensitive and overlap. Case-insensitive search maps each code point with ICU u_toupper. A character whose uppercase form is longer than one code point is left unchanged, so ß does not match SS.
origin.example:
found <- stri_detect_fixed(c("stringi R", "R STRINGI", "123"), "R")
cat(paste0('stri_detect_fixed(c("stringi R", "R STRINGI", "123"), "R") returns ', paste(found, collapse = ", "), '.\n'))

translation.description: Report whether each string contains at least one literal match.
translation.usage: stri_detect_fixed(str, pattern, negate=False, max_count=-1, opts_fixed=None, case_insensitive=None, overlap=None)

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: String, missing value, or list of those.

arguments.name: pattern
arguments.text: Literal pattern, missing value, or list of those.

arguments.name: negate
arguments.text: If true, report strings that do not match.

arguments.name: max_count
arguments.text: Stop after this many results of interest. -1 inspects every element. Later elements are NA.

arguments.name: opts_fixed
arguments.text: None, or a dict of search settings. Overlap is ignored.

arguments.name: case_insensitive
arguments.text: If given, search without regard to the simple uppercase mapping.

arguments.name: overlap
arguments.text: Ignored, as in the installed function.

translation.details: Recycling follows the longer input. When pattern is not a single string, elements may be visited out of order, which changes which tail becomes NA once max_count is reached. An empty string follows negate. An empty pattern or a missing value is NA. A missing opts_fixed uses case-sensitive search without overlap. A dict may set case_insensitive and overlap. Case-insensitive search maps each code point with ICU u_toupper. A character whose uppercase form is longer than one code point is left unchanged, so ß does not match SS.
translation.value: A list of True, False, and NA.
translation.example:
from stringi.fixed import stri_detect_fixed
found = stri_detect_fixed(["stringi R", "R STRINGI", "123"], "R")
print('stri_detect_fixed(["stringi R", "R STRINGI", "123"], "R") returns ' + ", ".join(str(item) for item in found) + ".")
